POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 10, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM
Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Acting Chair Julie Lie, called the meeting to order at 2:03 PM.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Acting Chair Julie Lie presiding.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54314  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee meeting of
  Monday, January 13, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Bedy

2.  25-54316  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Clean Sweeps Public
  Works transfer cost opportunity with Homeless Services Staff.

  • The subcommittee continued the discussion on the 2024 encampment
  cleanups and would like to recommend in the 2025 policy recommendations
  that 10% of the encampment budget be reallocated toward a pilot program
  focused on sanitation and hygiene measures. Additionally the chair would
  like to recommend including ADU compliance portable restrooms and
  showers at three of the largest encampments.
  • The acting chair requested for a substitute motion. The new motion is to

  sanitation program to be included in the 2025 HSAC policies for the city
  council.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Bedy

3.  25-54318  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding the quarterly
  Homeless Services Update from the Homeless Services Advisory Committee on
  Wednesday, February 5, 2025.

  • The subcommittee discussed the types of data that they would like to see
  included in the quarterly staff updates, as well as the possibility of removing
  the staff report currently presented during the HSAC meetings. Member
  Doug Killion requested trending data of interim shelter beds.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Bedy

4.  25-54362  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the draft policies and

  • This item has been postponed for discussion at the March meeting.

  A motion was made by Member Chotiswatdi, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0 None

5.  25-54319  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the 2024-2025 HSAC Policy
  Recommendations.

  • The acting chair Julie Lie, provided an update on behalf of Chair Sarah
  Bedy. Sarah requested clarification on the goals the city is setting following
  the Built for Zero presentation from the January meeting. She is also seeking
  an update on the Homeless prevention rental assistance program.
  • Members of the subcommittee expressed interest in a quarterly report on
  Built for Zero, including data updates on the chronically homeless
  population.
  • Subcommittee member Doug Killion suggested the update announced by
  Mayor Richardson regarding the goal to end youth homeless should be
  included into the updated recommendations. The subcommittee would like to
  see data being reported back to a visual format that clearly shows the plan
  and progress.

  A motion was made by Member Chotiswatdi, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Bedy

6.  25-54315  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding future agenda items.

  • The future agenda items include regular items that will be moved to the next
  meeting.

  A motion was made by Member Chotiswatdi, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Bedy

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No Public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • The subcommittee members are seeking an explanation as to why the city is not moving
  forward with the project to construct and initially operate a 33-unit modular tiny home, despite
  having received a $5.6 million state grant for this purpose. They are specifically requesting
  clarification on why the city has decided to return the funds and not proceed with the project.

ADJOURNMENT

Acting Chair Julie Lie, adjourns the meeting at 3:07pm.
